summary: Every DELETE handler requires --yes (or an interactive confirm); POST/PATCH 5xx responses must not be retried; MCP path params must be PathEscaped.
reason: Generated mutate handlers skip the advertised confirmation gate — including body-bearing DELETEs such as contents delete-file — the HTTP client retried every method on 5xx (duplicating GitHub writes), and MCP path substitution inserted raw strings so ?, #, and % in content paths were parsed as URL syntax. A regen must preserve fail-closed deletes on all DELETE endpoints, idempotent-only 5xx retries, and escaped MCP paths.
validated_outcome: confirmDestructive rejects non-interactive deletes without --yes; POST 500 issues one HTTP call; MCP contents path with reserved characters is percent-encoded.
